eevee-skill-quick-attack.name: Quick Attack
eevee-skill-quick-attack.description: New skill: a darting strike up to 2 hexes away, no line of sight needed (Power 45).

eevee-anticipation.name: Anticipation
eevee-anticipation.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

eevee-adaptive-genes.name: Adaptive Genes
eevee-adaptive-genes.description: +1 HP, +1 Attack, +1 Sp. Atk and +1 Speed.

eevee-skill-helping-hand.name: Helping Hand
eevee-skill-helping-hand.description: New skill: an ally up to 2 hexes away becomes Focused for 2 turns.

eevee-skill-wish.name: Wish
eevee-skill-wish.description: New skill: a wish heals it or an ally up to 2 hexes away by 30 HP.

eevee-evolving-instinct.name: Evolving Instinct
eevee-evolving-instinct.description: Knocking out a foe gives +1 Attack (this battle, max +3).

eevee-adaptive-hide.name: Adaptive Hide
eevee-adaptive-hide.description: Cannot be Burned or Frozen; +1 Defense.

eevee-skill-last-resort.name: Last Resort
eevee-skill-last-resort.description: New skill: an all-out melee strike (Power 95).

eevee-skill-elemental-burst.name: Elemental Burst
eevee-skill-elemental-burst.description: New skill: a blast of its type up to 3 hexes away (Power 85), e.g. Hydro Pump.

eevee-sturdy-heart.name: Sturdy Heart
eevee-sturdy-heart.description: Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.

eevee-eager.name: Eager
eevee-eager.description: +1 extra Bond when it knocks out a foe.

eevee-skill-elemental-fang.name: Elemental Fang
eevee-skill-elemental-fang.description: New skill: a melee bite of its type (Power 80) that pushes 1 hex, e.g. Fire Fang.

eevee-skill-safeguard.name: Safeguard
eevee-skill-safeguard.description: New skill: it and adjacent allies are Fortified for 2 turns.

eevee-opportunist.name: Opportunist
eevee-opportunist.description: +20% damage against foes with a status effect.

eevee-second-nature.name: Second Nature
eevee-second-nature.description: Heals 4% of its max HP each turn.

eevee-adaptability.name: Adaptability
eevee-adaptability.description: Capstone. Normal, Water, Electric and Fire moves deal 25% more damage.

eevee-evolutions-edge.name: Evolution's Edge
eevee-evolutions-edge.description: Capstone. A KO on its turn refreshes its basic attack; takes 10% less damage.
